title: collea calcarata
intro: Collea calcarata, commonly known as the "Fragrant Orchid", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality, thanks to its sedative and antispasmodic effects.
